These stub compact indexes model an optional scoped dependency whose children must be searched in the parent registry before the global registry. A newer global child must not replace a scoped child. A missing scoped child falls back to the global registry. Explicit declarations override inherited routes, and two scoped registries supplying an unpinned child are ambiguous. The `/versions` listing identifies available scoped names before probing child metadata. This models registries that error on unknown names. Omitted HTTP entries return 404; registries without a versions listing can confirm missing gems through the metadata lookup.
